items.a: We are in the Gardens directly in front of the Bathroom Pavilion. If you can find the Pavilion, you will find us.

While we will never turn away food, the easiest and most effective way to help is to Venmo Ben Pierce (@ben-pierce-23) — or hand him some cash. Give what feels right (about $10 an adult if you hang out for a while). Kids are always on us. All proceeds go to funding the tailgate.
We have a special menu for every game. You're gonna love it. Check the Schedule page for what's cooking each week.

We'll have plenty of beer and some special concoctions. Want to get fancy? BYOB. Please drink responsibly — you must be 21 to consume alcohol. We'll also have sodas and water to keep everyone hydrated. Please finish your drink before opening another; we find a million half-full cans and it's a huge waste. Encourage your kids to do the same.

items.q: Where's the best place to park?
items.a: With a parking pass: Lot 320-322 (used to be Lot 56). Without a pass: the Fayetteville High School lot — usually about $20, not a far walk, and a great cause.
